name: PrivaraUnmask_Analyze
author: TAJ APPS LLC (Privara)
description: Privara Unmask, the Android malware sandbox that recovers the C2: extract the command-and-control (C2) servers of an Android malware sample (APK, XAPK, APKM, .apks). Pay only for results, from a prepaid Privara wallet.

configurationItems.name: api_key
configurationItems.description: Unmask API key (pvu_...) with the submit and read scopes, from https://app.tajapps.com/dashboard/unmask/api

configurationItems.name: max_wait
configurationItems.description: Seconds to wait for the analysis before reporting it as still running (keep it below the Cortex job timeout)

configurationItems.name: poll_interval
configurationItems.description: First delay in seconds between two status checks when the API gives no Retry-After (grows up to 120 s, never below 15 s)

configurationItems.name: max_file_size_mb
configurationItems.description: Optional lower size cap in MB (by default the Unmask API's own limit is used)
